unsupported: The business began as a one-person shop focused on hand-tool joinery and custom woodworking.

Clients have included the New Mexico House of Representatives, for which the shop built a walnut speaker’s gavel, along with residential customers seeking custom furniture and musicians commissioning guitar bodies.

Weller emphasizes that each piece is hand made and hand crafted using traditional woodworking techniques, a distinction he attributes to the use of hand tools and time-honored joinery rather than automated production.

Known for: Handcrafted using traditional woodworking techniques and hand tools; Custom furniture, guitars, and caskets made to order; Each piece hand made and hand crafted by Dylan Weller; Commissioned work for institutional clients such as the New Mexico House of Representatives
